description.value: Kal Tire Place (listed in OSM as Kal Tire Arena) is Vernon's primary multi-use indoor sports facility, hosting ice hockey and lacrosse on its main ice surface. Operated by the City of Vernon, it is the home venue for local competitive hockey leagues and occasional regional events. A touring cyclist passing through Vernon is unlikely to visit as a destination, though the arena sits within the city's broader recreation complex.
